From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: Demo Pod C tilt — immediate relocation & livestream failover

Team, Marta,

Quick heads-up from the show floor — Demo Pod C has a noticeable lean after the afternoon load-in. Photos attached (pod_photos_1.jpg). It looks like one corner of the riser shifted — attendees are being kept back but I want to be cautious.

Immediate asks:
- Tessa: please secure cordon and get floor tape / signage up around Pod C now.
- Marta: can your rigging crew check the riser and confirm whether we need to stabilize in place or move the pod? If we move, what’s the earliest slot your crew can do the lift + re-level?
- Ben: we’ll likely need to delay the 10:00 live demo for 30–45 minutes (contingency). Can you prepare a short customer-facing update in case Lucas needs to notify his attendees?
- Operations: if we move Pod C, we need livestream failover to the backup encoder (details below) and an alternate IP for the encoder stream.

Proposed immediate fallback (to speed coordination):
- Move Pod C to Zone 7 (adjacent demo lane) for temporary staging. Zone 7 has cleared power and a secondary encoder connection.
- Switch live feed to backup encoder: https://backup-encoders.redwood.com/session/enc-42 (I’ve notified SRE).

Attachments: pod_photos_1.jpg (photo set), I’ll follow with a short incident form once we confirm.

If you’re onsite, please reply with ETA. If offsite, flag any blockers.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
Aditya: +1 415-555-0121

Hi Aditya / team,

Thanks for the photo — I’ve forwarded to my rigging lead. Quick update:
- We have a two-person rigging crew onsite and can be at Pod C in 10 minutes.
- Based on the images, looks like the corner plate has slipped on the riser; we can either: stabilize in place with a shoring plate (15–20 minutes) or remount to a spare base and move the pod to Zone 7 (30–45 minutes).
- I’m attaching the stabilizer spec we’d use for in-place shoring (stabilizer_spec.pdf).

Notes / requirements:
- If you choose stabilize-in-place we need the area cleared and the lead time of ~20 minutes for the jack kit.
- If you choose relocation, we’ll need a clear 6ft path and a POC on the floor to direct traffic and clear cabling.

We recommend relocation to Zone 7 only if you can accept the 30–45 minute delay and the livestream switch — otherwise shoring in place is faster.

Marta Lopez
Operations Lead, StageCraft Events
M: +1 213-555-0105
Attachments: stabilizer_spec.pdf

Team / Marta,

Decision made at 09:50 after quick floor check: relocate Pod C to Zone 7. Reasons: safer for attendees long run, Zone 7 has better cable routing and spare power, and relocation gives clean visuals for the demo.

Confirmed actions (summary):
- Marta / StageCraft: move pod now. Rigging ETA 10 minutes — use the spare base. Please sign off on incident_form_090.pdf after stabilization.
- Tessa: cordon lifted to allow staged move; please post the sign at 9:55am and coordinate crowd control.
- Ben: please send the short customer message to Lucas for attendee updates (use the copy you shared).
- Livestream: switched to backup encoder URL https://backup-encoders.redwood.com/session/enc-42 — SRE confirmed stream handshake. New livestream start (approx): 10:35 PDT.

Attachments completed and links:
- Incident form: incident_form_090.pdf (to be filed)
- Photos: uploaded to internal drive: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/events/Globex/PodC-photos
- Stabilizer spec (for record): stabilizer_spec.pdf
